method: Fresh before and after worlds from immutable binaries. Main original census bounds retained for eligible starts and spacing; paired R2 frame-window plan retained for conditional composition. Composition compares distributions in unions of complete piece boxes, pooled and by saved surface biome, not same-coordinate block identity. Eligible ours starts are generator candidates, not persisted starts. Positive generated-chunk tests separately cover recovered villages, camp terrain and ship hulls. Original census worlds/reports are read only.

village.cause: R2 changed chunk-center biome eligibility to chunk origin. Missing villages need the center of the rotated, selected first meeting-point frame. Grid spacing/separation/salt unchanged.
village.scope: Plains, desert and savanna first-piece pools. Rendered village layouts remain captured approximations; taiga first pool and snowy library unverified.

camp.cause: Missing terrain adaptation; cropped frames had already been corrected in R2. Natural-reference comparison finds terrain removed inside Keep cells above the shared ground plane. Pieces must be placed after adaptation to preserve floors and loot.

shared_files.src/world/structure_terrain.rs: One line adds camp beards to existing adaptation collection.
shared_files.src/world/mod.rs: Move camp build after existing adaptation pass; no vegetation implementation edits.

camp.limits: Existing adaptation falloff remains approximate [проверить]. Ground-level alignment and terrain removal measured; no claim of exact density formula.
camp.saved_control_note: Direct generated-chunk tests produce air at all six points. Saved server world has five air and one water at (326,60,879); original soil removed in all six. Cause of post-generation water not isolated [проверить].

ship_height.cause: Median sampled every two blocks in the rotated frame was wrong. Underwater 26.3 uses integer mean of first-free heights over all columns of unrotated template size at TP. Coral and later decorations excluded. Legacy and beached behavior retained.
ship_height.known_limits: Original terrain maps validate the rule, not coordinate equality of our terrain heights. Beached burial, wood-palette random stream and remaining pooled composition failures [проверить].

stronghold.cause: Stale stronghold_biased_to list omitted sulfur_caves, added in 26.2. Dappled forest remains excluded.
stronghold.remaining: 96/256 relocation disagreements, including second-seed first ring. Both lost exact matches replay correctly against freshly measured official preferred masks; our biome masks still differ. No coordinate exceptions added.

pyramid.cause: Our underlying terrain corners are submerged; correct dry-site rejection removes the candidate. Fresh official terrain-only reference is dry. No coordinate whitelist or arbitrary height offset accepted.
pyramid.status: [проверить] Terrain-height discrepancy outside structure-module ownership; pyramid rule not relaxed.

wood_pairs.method: Read only naturally generated saved blocks at transformed wood cells of our own measured templates. Votes compare wood name only for matching block-kind suffix; no archive, template dump or game code. Only 102 of 107 metadata fixtures supplied both wood groups from saved chunks. Remaining 5 were not counted as failures or successes.
wood_pairs.status: [проверить] Independent palette stream not recovered; chunk selection stream skip hypotheses did not reproduce observed woods. No guessed replacement accepted.
wood_pairs.note: Selector unchanged in R3; original 102 observed pairs rechecked by the same own roll formula. Height fixes do not establish palette-stream coincidence.
